title: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)
subtitle: Non-Parametric Distance Voting (2D & 3D Toggle)
summary: Classify query points by majority vote among the K closest neighbors in 2D or 3D space.

evaluationChart.title: Validation Accuracy vs. K Value
evaluationChart.description: Leave-one-out cross-validation accuracy across K=1..15 showing overfitting at K=1 and underfitting at large K.

advantages: Zero training phase: naturally adapts to arbitrary non-linear decision boundaries.
Simple to understand and trivial to update with new labeled data.
Works seamlessly for both classification and regression.
limitations: O(n · d) inference cost: slow on large datasets without KD-trees/Ball-trees.
Suffers from the Curse of Dimensionality in high-dimensional spaces.
Extremely sensitive to unscaled features and noisy local outliers.

formulas.label: Euclidean Distance
formulas.description: Measures straight-line distance from query point q to training point x_i.

formulas.label: Majority Vote Prediction
formulas.description: Assigns the most frequent class among the K nearest neighbors N_K(q).

hyperparameters.label: Neighbors (K)
hyperparameters.description: Number of nearest neighbors voting on the query label.

codeTemplates.fromScratch:
import numpy as np
from collections import Counter

def knn_predict(X_train, y_train, q, k=5):
    dists = np.linalg.norm(X_train - q, axis=1)
    k_idx = np.argsort(dists)[:k]
    votes = Counter(y_train[k_idx])
    return votes.most_common(1)[0][0]
codeTemplates.scikitLearn:
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
import numpy as np

X = np.array([[1.6,2.2],[2.1,3.0],[5.5,6.4],[6.8,7.1]])
y = np.array([0, 0, 1, 1])

model = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=3))
model.fit(X, y)
print('Prediction:', model.predict([[4.0, 4.5]]))
